findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new disconnected TestLogger, discarding all contextual logs
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`, which allocates a fresh `*TestLogger` instance that the caller has no reference to. In `pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go` (line 58), `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` was updated to call `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. When `LoggerMiddleware` (or any other component) is tested with `TestLogger`, the `.Info(...)` call mutates the temporary `TestLogger` returned by `FromContext` and discards it, leaving `InfoLogs` on the original `TestLogger` empty (`Calls == 0`). Additionally, because `LoggerMiddleware` no longer appends `pluginId`, `endpoint`, `uname`, `dsName`, or `dsUID` directly and `TestLogger.FromContext` ignores `ctx`, existing `LoggerMiddleware` unit tests cannot observe those attributes or the log call itself.

findings.title: ContextualLoggerMiddleware dereferences req without nil check and lacks unit tests
findings.body: In `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`, `QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` immediately access `req.PluginContext` without checking `if req == nil`. Other middlewares in this package (such as `LoggerMiddleware`, which runs immediately after `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`) explicitly guard against `req == nil` and pass the call through to `m.next`. A nil request will now panic in `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` before reaching `LoggerMiddleware`. Additionally, no unit tests were added for `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`.
